wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 12-002 connects the Options/Sound/Screen settings menus to vanilla config persistence via one src/vanilla facade (wireSettingsMenusToConfig.ts) re-exporting the read-only per-category persist modules (persist-sound-settings, persist-screen-settings incl. the show_messages toggle, persist-mouse-settings, persist-vanilla-key-bindings, persist-chat-macros) plus hostConfig (compatibility / extended host cfg) and the MenuAction settings vocabulary type from src/ui/menus.ts. VANILLA_SETTINGS_CONFIG_INVARIANTS pins six rules binding each category to its vanilla cfg variables (sound volumes [0,15] + device ids 0-9; screen messages/screenblocks 3-11/detail 0-1/gamma 0-4; five mouse vars; ten DOS-scancode key bindings in the 30-col layout; ten chat-macro slots; compatibility in the extended host cfg). The focused test exercises real create/serialize round-trips, the constants, the messages/gamma serialization, the multi-line-tolerant ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax); value/type split. Only src/ui/menus.ts is importer-tracked among the re-exported modules (the src/config persist modules + hostConfig are not importer-tracked by inventory-save-and-config-modules.json).
